prompt: Convert workspace/people.csv into workspace/people.json: a JSON list of objects with name (string), age (integer) and city (string), sorted by age descending and then by name ascending.

fixtures.content:
name,age,city
"Smith, Anna",34,Lima
Bruno Diaz,41,Quito
Carla Ruiz,34,Bogota
"Doe, John",29,Lima
Elena Soto,41,Quito

argv: import json; d = json.load(open('people.json')); expected = [{'name': 'Bruno Diaz', 'age': 41, 'city': 'Quito'}, {'name': 'Elena Soto', 'age': 41, 'city': 'Quito'}, {'name': 'Carla Ruiz', 'age': 34, 'city': 'Bogota'}, {'name': 'Smith, Anna', 'age': 34, 'city': 'Lima'}, {'name': 'Doe, John', 'age': 29, 'city': 'Lima'}]; assert d == expected, d
